about: Dean 12 Nov 2026 (INBOX 295): a real night on the Kogan TV app broke in about 30 ways while the gate was green. One row per fault from that week: the check that would have gone red, the words inside that check, and the prove-checks row that breaks the fault on purpose. tools/never-again.test.py fails if a row loses its check, its words or its prove row, or if a fault has none (status 'gap' needs a note and a date).
